attempts.text:
MRUNAL KHERDE 

Scrum Master, Agile Facilitator  

 

mrunalkherde12@gmail.com | www.linkedin.com/in/mrunal-kherde-a564b1223 

 Pune, Maharashtra, 411057, India | +91 8010127894 

 

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 

Results-driven Scrum Master with 4+ years of experience leading Agile teams using Scrum and SAFe 

methodologies to deliver high-quality software and business solutions. Skilled in facilitating Agile 

ceremonies, removing impediments, managing stakeholder communication, and driving continuous 

improvement. Proficient in Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, and Rally for sprint planning, backlog 

management, and release tracking. Strong collaborator with a focus on team productivity, Agile maturity, 

and successful project delivery. 

 

WORK EXPERIENCE 

Application Development Analyst / Scrum Master                                                                   March 2022 - Present  

ACCENTURE | Pune 

• Facilitated Scrum and SAFe ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, 

and PI planning to ensure smooth Agile delivery and continuous improvement. 

• Collaborated with RTE, Product Owners and stakeholders to manage backlog readiness, prioritize 

user stories, refine requirements, and align delivery with business goals and release timelines. 

• Managed sprint execution, delivery tracking, and Agile workflows using Azure DevOps, Jira, and 

Confluence while maintaining dashboards for velocity, burndown, sprint progress, and release 

readiness. 

• Coordinated with cross-functional onshore/offshore teams to manage dependencies, align project 

milestones, and support successful Data & Analytics project delivery. 

• Identified and resolved impediments, risks, and issues, escalating critical concerns when needed to 

maintain delivery predictability and team efficiency. 

• Communicated regularly with Engagement Managers, project team members, and representatives 

from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require 

additional attention and consideration from engagement management. 

Additional Responsibilities 

• Managed demand intake, resource planning, and project prioritization across multiple engagements. 

• Oversaw project timelines, budgets, risks, and dependencies to support successful delivery 

execution. 

• Collaborated with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to drive process improvements and 

operational efficiency. 

• Applied strong analytical and organizational skills to manage multiple projects and delivery priorities 

effectively. 

http://www.linkedin.com/in/mrunal-kherde-a564b1223


• Independently and collaboratively led client engagement workstreams focused on process 

improvement, optimization, and transformation, including implementing leading practice workflows, 

addressing quality gaps, and driving operational outcomes. 

 

AGILE & PROJECT MANAGEMENT SKILLS 

• Agile & Scrum (Scrum, SAFe), Project Delivery & Governance 

• Sprint/PI Planning, Daily stand ups, Backlog & Release Management, Retrospective 

• Agile Metrics (Velocity, Burndown) & Reporting 

• Stakeholder & Cross-Team Coordination 

• SDLC, Risk & Dependency Management 

• Tools: JIRA, Azure DevOps, Rally, Confluence 

• Demand & Resource Management 

• Agile Coaching & Continuous Improvement 

Expertise: 

Project Management, Demand Management, Scrum Master, Business Analysis, 

Requirements Gathering, SDLC Coordination, Agile Reporting & Execution 

 

EDUCATION 

Bachelor of Engineering (Information Technology)  

Sant Gadge Baba Amravati University, Maharashtra                                                                      Graduated: 2021 

 

CGPA: 9.63  

 

CERTIFICATIONS 

• Reinvention with Agentic AI certified (Accenture)  

• Actively preparing for Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification to further strengthen Agile and 

Scrum expertise 

 

LANGUAGES 

• English 

• Marathi 

• Hindi
